L0: # The Product object
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L3: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L4: 
L5: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L6: 
L7: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L8: > Nested parameters, fields, and event types on API reference pages are collapsed by default. Use the provided `?query=<name>` links to show the full definitions. Request the page with an empty `?query=` to expand every entry at once.
L9: ### The Product object
L10: 
L11: ```json
L12: {
L13:   "id": "prod_NWjs8kKbJWmuuc",
L14:   "object": "product",
L15:   "active": true,
L16:   "created": 1678833149,
L17:   "default_price": null,
L18:   "description": null,
L19:   "images": [],
L20:   "marketing_features": [],
L21:   "livemode": false,
L22:   "metadata": {},
L23:   "name": "Gold Plan",
L24:   "package_dimensions": null,
L25:   "shippable": null,
L26:   "statement_descriptor": null,
L27:   "tax_code": null,
L28:   "unit_label": null,
L29:   "updated": 1678833149,
L30:   "url": null
L31: }
L32: ```
L33: ## Attributes
L34: 
L35: - `id` (string)
L36:   Unique identifier for the object.
L37: 
L38: - `object` (string, value is "product")
L39:   String representing the object’s type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
L40: 
L41: - `active` (boolean)
L42:   Whether the product is currently available for purchase.
L43: 
L44: - `created` (timestamp)
L45:   Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
L46: - `default_price` (string, nullable, expandable (can be expanded into an object with the `expand` request parameter))
L47:   The ID of the [Price](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices.md) object that is the default price for this product.
L48: 
L49: - `description` (string, nullable)
L50:   The product’s description, meant to be displayable to the customer. Use this field to optionally store a long form explanation of the product being sold for your own rendering purposes.
L51: - `images` (array of strings)
L52:   A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product, meant to be displayable to the customer.
L53: 
L54: - `livemode` (boolean)
L55:   If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
L56: - [`marketing_features`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/products/object.md?query=marketing_features) (array of objects)
L57:   A list of up to 15 marketing features for this product. These are displayed in [pricing tables](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/pricing-table.md).
L58: 
L59: - `metadata` (map)
L60:   Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata.md) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
L61: - `name` (string)
L62:   The product’s name, meant to be displayable to the customer.
L63: 
L64: - [`package_dimensions`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/products/object.md?query=package_dimensions) (object, nullable)
L65:   The dimensions of this product for shipping purposes.
L66: 
L67: - `shippable` (boolean, nullable)
L68:   Whether this product is shipped (i.e., physical goods).
L69: - `statement_descriptor` (string, nullable)
L70:   Extra information about a product which will appear on your customer’s credit card statement. In the case that multiple products are billed at once, the first statement descriptor will be used. Only used for subscription payments.
L71: 
L72: - `tax_code` (string, nullable, expandable (can be expanded into an object with the `expand` request parameter))
L73:   A [tax code](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-categories.md) ID.
L74: - [`tax_details`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/products/object.md?query=tax_details) (object, nullable)
L75:   Tax details for this product, including the [tax code](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-codes.md) and an optional performance location.
L76: 
L77: - `unit_label` (string, nullable)
L78:   A label that represents units of this product. When set, this will be included in customers’ receipts, invoices, Checkout, and the customer portal.
L79: - `updated` (timestamp)
L80:   Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
L81: 
L82: - `url` (string, nullable)
L83:   A URL of a publicly-accessible webpage for this product.
